data-retention-body:
We are allowed by law required to retain certain records for a period of at least five years after closure of your Avantio Channel Manager contract which will include your business data (including users data) and your clients, owners, intermediary agents or suppliers. Otherwise, to comply with the principles of the new regulation, we will delete and destroy all personal data that we hold about you when you (or we) terminate your Avantio Channel Manager contract.

In accordance with the rights conferred by current legislation on the protection of Personal Data, you may exercise your rights of access, rectification, limitation of processing, deletion, portability and opposition by sending your request to the following address contact@avantio.com.
data-security-body:
We are committed to the security of your data. We strive to protect the information you provide to us from loss and misuse, as well as from unauthorized disclosure or access. These measures take into account the sensitivity of the information we collect, process and store, as well as the state of the art of current technology. Once logged into App Avantio, all internet communication -including channel manager connections- is secured using Secure Socket Layer (SSL) technology.

Given the nature of communications and information processing technology, we cannot guarantee that the Information, during its transmission over the Internet or during its storage on our systems or otherwise at our expense, will be absolutely secure from intrusion by others.

If you are concerned that any of your data have been compromised, please contact immediately our Customer Support department and tell us the reasons why you think your data have been compromised. Once we have received your information, we will use strict procedures and security features to prevent unauthorised access.

privacy-policy-introduction:
In accordance with the current legislation for the protection of personal data, INTERNET TOURISM SOLUTIONS S.L (registered number: B97090138) office registered at C/ Charles Robert Darwin 5 46980, Paterna - Valencia, Spain (“we”) take your company’s Data Protection extremely seriously and is therefore committed to protecting your information and respecting your privacy.

This Privacy Policy, together with the Service Agreement (and any other documents referred to in it), sets out the basis on which we will treat any personal data that we collect from you, or that you provide to us, through your account on our Avantio Channel Manager software. When you fill out any forms, talk to our staff, send us any details or requests for information and use our software, we will collect, use and disclose your personal information as described below.

NOTE: Any changes we make in this Privacy Policy will be posted on this page. Any new Privacy Policy will be effective from the time that it is posted on Avantio Channel Manager App. We reserve the right to make changes to our Privacy Policy at any time, without notice, when is required by applicable legislation. If we make any material changes to the way your personal data are used, we will notify you by an acceptance email before to the change becoming effective. we-communicate-third-body:
We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

In case of need and in order to fulfill our legal obligations and to comply with the provision of the service, we will communicate information about you to third parties such as public administrations and all those entities with whom communication is necessary in order to comply with the provision of the aforementioned service (we require these third parties to not use your personal information for any other purpose).

The fact of not providing the data to the aforementioned entities implies that the provision of the services cannot be fulfilled.

We use your information mainly to operate and administer your Avantio Channel Manager account and to provide services that you have requested, in order to meet the commitments arising from the contract signed between both parties. Also to allow you to participate in new features of the software.

airbnb-lts-cancellation-policy-empty-tex: For all bookings of 28 days or more, the long-stay policy will apply and will override your standard cancellation policy in such cases.
airbnb-lts-cancellation-policy-fair-desc: To receive a full refund, guests must cancel at least 30 days before check-in. If a guest cancels after that, you’ll be paid 100% for all nights spent, plus 30 additional nights. If fewer than 30 days remain on the reservation when the guest cancels, you’ll be paid 100% for all of those remaining nights.
airbnb-lts-cancellation-policy-with-grac: To receive a full refund, guests must cancel within 48 hours of booking, and the cancellation must occur at least 28 days before check-in. If a guest cancels after that, you’ll be paid 100% for all nights spent, plus 30 additional nights. If fewer than 30 days remain on the reservation when the guest cancels, you’ll be paid 100% for all of those remaining nights.

Guests can cancel until 14 days before check-in for a full refund, and you won’t be paid.
If they cancel between 7 and 14 days before check-in, but after the 24-hour cancellation period, you’ll be paid 50% for all nights.
If they cancel less than 7 days before check-in, you’ll be paid 100% for all nights.
